invalidHandoff: Paperclip Cloud returned an invalid sign-in handoff.
expired: This sign-in expired. Start the connection again.
forbidden: Paperclip Cloud could not authorize this connection for your account.
unavailable: Paperclip Cloud couldn’t prepare secure sign-in. Try again.
invalidProviderAddress: Paperclip Cloud returned an invalid provider sign-in address.
urlMissing: This server did not provide a sign-in address.
urlMalformed: This server's sign-in address is not a valid URL, so Paperclip stopped.
urlScheme: This server's sign-in address does not use https, so Paperclip stopped.
urlInsecure: This server's sign-in address is not secure (https), so Paperclip stopped.
urlCredentials: This server's sign-in address hides a different site behind a username, so Paperclip stopped.
urlFragment: This server's sign-in address is malformed for sign-in, so Paperclip stopped.
prepareFailed: Paperclip couldn’t prepare the provider sign-in. Try again.
refreshing: Your Paperclip sign-in is being refreshed.
opening: Paperclip is opening the provider securely.
returnExpired: This sign-in expired. Return to Paperclip and start the connection again.
refreshFailed: Paperclip couldn’t refresh this sign-in. Try again to continue.
